plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Sell QQQ, QQQI, and SMH as they are flagged SELL or below stop.
Buy MSFT at 10% as a top-quality name with a strong scanner read.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect modest returns with tighter risk controls.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce overall leverage.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQ, QQQI, and SMH as they are flagged SELL or below stop.
Buy SNOW at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small leveraged component.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces concentration and leverage while adding quality tech. Expect moderate returns with controlled drawdown.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, to lean into leveraged ETFs.
Trim SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQ, QQQI, and SMH as they are flagged SELL or below stop.
Buy SNOW at 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup for aggressive growth.
This plan uses leverage and concentration for higher potential returns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of higher potential drawdown and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for income focus.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to increase income exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell QQQ, SMH, and CRWD to reduce high-beta and flagged holdings.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth, rotating into income ETFs. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
